description:
Dr. Pierre Kory speaks on January 4 on the FLCCC webinar on our "new normal."
Media, Propaganda, Censorship: You are complicit!Show more *****
"This mass delusion that we’re all under through unrelenting propaganda and censorship. They are censoring all these things. If I have to read one more article of a young person dying where the word vaccine isn't even mentioned as a possibility...it's absolutely disgusting. And…every journalist who goes to work and writes that article and refuses to talk about what's in everyone's mind — you are complicit. You want to keep your job because you can't write the article that you know you're supposed to write and morally and ethically supposed to write which is the truth, the facts. You give all of the information that's available. You can talk about possibilities. You can write an article where it doesn't say it is the vaccine but you could, maybe, if you had ethics or morals or honesty or integrity or courage or conviction you might want to write that ...hey, maybe it's the vaccine?" - Dr. Pierre Kory
